title: 地下室换阀门  (Down in the Cellar)

segments.t: Down in the brick cellar beneath the courtyard, Qing hands Chen the new brass valve while shining a bright flashlight onto the silent water heater. Listen first.
老陈，两个铜阀门给你！喘口气？没空！
手电筒拿稳，照着这儿的水管接口。
拿稳了！你已经关掉总水阀了吗？
关掉了，水也放空了。把左边那把重扳手递给我。
这把大铁扳手吗？给你。
一圈，两圈……看新铜螺纹咬合得多干净。
一滴水都不漏！现在可以点着热水器了吗？
把蓝色转轮慢慢往左拧开——别太快。
慢慢拧……听！水冲进来了！
火苗亮了——稳稳的蓝火，正合适。
摸摸铜管！已经热起来了！
三分钟就能送上三楼。今天跑得漂亮，搭档。
Now let's go through it line by line with the English translation.
老陈，两个铜阀门给你！喘口气？没空！
'Chen, here are both brass valves! Catch my breath? No time!'
手电筒拿稳，照着这儿的水管接口。
'Hold the flashlight steady and shine it on the pipe joint here.'
拿稳了！你已经关掉总水阀了吗？
'Steady! Did you turn off the main water valve already?'
关掉了，水也放空了。把左边那把重扳手递给我。
'Turned off and drained. Pass me that heavy wrench on your left.'
这把大铁扳手吗？给你。
'This big iron wrench? Here you go.'
一圈，两圈……看新铜螺纹咬合得多干净。
'One turn, two turns... look how cleanly the new brass thread fits.'
一滴水都不漏！现在可以点着热水器了吗？
'Not a single drop leaking! Can we light the water heater now?'
把蓝色转轮慢慢往左拧开——别太快。
'Turn the blue wheel open slowly to the left—not too fast.'
慢慢拧……听！水冲进来了！
'Turning slowly... listen! Water is rushing in!'
火苗亮了——稳稳的蓝火，正合适。
'The flame is lit—steady blue fire, right as it should be.'
摸摸铜管！已经热起来了！
'Touch the copper pipe! It is warming up already!'
三分钟就能送上三楼。今天跑得漂亮，搭档。
'Three minutes to reach the third floor. Fine run today, partner.'

A steady blue flame, warming copper pipes, and Chen even called Qing 'partner' instead of 'rookie'. Next time, Hao comes down from the attic for breakfast. See you next time.
